# EDA
## Data import
```{r}
month_data <- read.csv("VBRescue_Month.csv")
month_data <- month_data[is.na(month_data$Value)==FALSE,]
month_data$Metric <- factor(month_data$Metric)
month_data$Section <- factor(month_data$Section)
month_data$Sub_Section <- factor(month_data$Sub_Section)
month_data$Row_Type <- factor(month_data$Row_Type)

```

```{r}
table(month_data$Section, month_data$Sub_Section)
table(month_data$Section, month_data$Table)
summary(month_data)
```

### Split data by each section or total type

```{r}
total <- month_data[month_data$Row_Type=="Total",]

ambulance <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Ambulance (Primary Assignment)",]
training <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Members in Training",]
mpa <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Monthly Personnel Activity",]
recruit <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Recruits",]
spec_ops <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Special Operations (Primary Assignment)",]
support <- month_data[month_data$Section=="Support and Administrative",]

```

```{r}
ambulance_total <- ambulance[ambulance$Row_Type=="Total",]
ambulance_detail <- ambulance[ambulance$Row_Type!="Total",]

ggplot(ambulance_detail, aes(x = Month_Number, y = Value, colour = Metric)) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(
        title = "Detailed breakdown of ambulance data",
        x = "Months",
        y = "numbers of members"
      )

ggplot(ambulance_total, aes(x = Month_Number, y = Value, colour = Metric)) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(
        title = "Totals for ambulance data",
        x = "Months",
        y = "numbers of members"
      )
```
```{r}
mpa$Row_Type <- ifelse(grepl("Total", mpa$Metric), "Total", "Detail")

mpa_exit <- mpa[mpa$Sub_Section=="Total Exits",]
mpa_tot_exit <- aggregate(Value ~ Month_Number, data = mpa_exit, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
mpa_tot_exit$Table <- "Monthly Personnel Activity"
mpa_tot_exit$Section <- "Monthly Personnel Activity"
mpa_tot_exit$Sub_Section <- "Total Exits"
mpa_tot_exit$Metric <- "Total Exits"
mpa_tot_exit$Row_Type <- "Total"

mpa_new_qual <- mpa[grepl("Newly Qualified", mpa$Metric), ]
mpa_tot_newqual <- aggregate(Value ~ Month_Number, data = mpa_new_qual, sum, na.rm = TRUE)
mpa_tot_newqual$Table <- "Monthly Personnel Activity"
mpa_tot_newqual$Section <- "Monthly Personnel Activity"
mpa_tot_newqual$Sub_Section <- ""
mpa_tot_newqual$Metric <- "Total Newly Qualified Members"
mpa_tot_newqual$Row_Type <- "Total"

mpa_total0 <- rbind(mpa_tot_exit, mpa_tot_newqual)

mpa_total0$Month <- ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==1, "January", 
                          ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==2, "February",
                                 ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==3, "March",
                                        ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==4, "April",
                                               ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==5, "May",
                                                      ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==6, "June",
                                                             ifelse(mpa_total0$Month_Number==7, "July",
                                                                    "August")))))))

mpa_total <- mpa[grepl("Total", mpa$Metric),]
mpa_total <- rbind(mpa_total, mpa_total0)

mpa <- rbind(mpa, mpa_total0)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mpa_exit, aes(x = Month_Number, y = Value, colour = Metric)) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(
        title = "Exits - Monthly personnel activity data",
        x = "Months",
        y = "numbers of Exits"
      )

ggplot(mpa_new_qual, aes(x = Month_Number, y = Value, colour = Metric)) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(
        title = "Newly Qualified - Monthly personnel activity data",
        x = "Months",
        y = "numbers of Members Newly Qualified"
      )


ggplot(mpa_total, aes(x = Month_Number, y = Value, colour = Metric)) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(
        title = "Totals for Monthly personnel activity data",
        x = "Months",
        y = "numbers of members"
      )
```
